name: Change Comprehension
description: Whether a reviewer can understand a change-set faster than by reading its raw diff
positive_state: The reviewer understands a change-set faster than by reading the raw diff
negative_state: The reviewer falls back to reading hunks file by file, or rubber-stamps the change-set

name: Claim Verifiability
description: Whether agent claims about a change-set can be checked against evidence
positive_state: Agent claims sit on anchors and can be checked against evidence
negative_state: Claims hide in a sidebar and are trusted or ignored wholesale

name: Analysis Coverage
description: Whether evidence holds across the languages and repository shapes reviewers actually work in
positive_state: Evidence holds across the languages and repository shapes the reviewer works in
negative_state: Analysis degrades to directory guesses and the reviewer stops trusting it

name: Workspace Hygiene
description: Whether diffcore leaves the projects it reviews untouched
positive_state: Diffcore leaves reviewed projects untouched and can review itself
negative_state: State leaks into projects, causing gitignore churn and self-triggered reloads, and dogfooding breaks

name: Review Continuity
description: Whether review-sessions across projects survive restarts and switching
positive_state: Review-sessions across several projects survive restarts and switching
negative_state: Review state is lost or tangled between projects

name: Agent Collaboration Loop
description: Whether reviewer and agent converse through diffcore rather than around it
positive_state: Reviewer feedback is queued in diffcore and the agent answers or pushes back there
negative_state: Feedback is lost and the reviewer copies text between tools

name: Boundary Awareness
description: Whether reviewers can see how a change-set holds or crosses the boundaries its project declares
positive_state: The reviewer sees which project boundaries a change-set holds, crosses, or breaks
negative_state: Boundaries erode silently across change-sets until the project architecture exists only on paper
